text:
tao: FYI i ran the onboarding suite for cinder-embed-lite-int6 (per-channel 6-bit) on multilingual holdouts (en/pt/ko). weird: recall@1 stable, but recall@5/10 drop and cluster purity down. anyone seen this pattern? :eyeglasses:

mira: can you paste the eval config + top metrics?

tao: short paste below:

```
model: cinder-embed-lite-int6
calib: 1200 pooled random (en/pt/ko)
quant: per-channel symmetric, 6-bit
whitening: enabled
holdouts: en/pt/ko (8k each)
batching: micro=16
metrics:
  recall@1: 0.70 -> 0.70
  recall@5: 0.87 -> 0.83
  recall@10: 0.92 -> 0.89
  cluster_purity: 0.76 -> 0.62
  idflip_rate: 0.5% -> 2.5%
```

oz: idflip x5 and purity drop suggests some channels are miscalibrated. did you inspect per-dim activation counts?

tao: i pulled per-dim activation counts and skew. a handful of dims are nearly zero on the pooled calib set but spike on real holdouts (rare-token signals).

frank: that smells like calibration sampling bias. stratified sampling by token-frequency deciles often helps. also try per-language calibration for multilingual tables.

mira: also run a cosine-only eval (L2 normalize embeddings) so we can see if magnitude shifts are the main culprit.

tao: queued two experiments: (A) stratified-calib n=2500 (freq-deciles + lang split) (B) unit-norm postproc run. eval-bot will post results.

eval-bot: run 1768129999 submitted. results (per-cluster recall, centroid deltas, nn histograms) will be available at https://internal.eval/1768129999 when finished.

oz: if stratified helps, we should change the default sampling in the quant pipeline to "stratified_by_freq" for embedding tables with a fallback random when pool < 500. tiny PR with flag default on should be enough.

tao: micro-results from stratified small-holdout (2k each): recall@5 +1.3 pts, cluster_purity +0.09, idflip -> 1.0%. centroid L2 median delta reduced from 0.12 -> 0.05. still 2 clusters with delta >0.4 (pt tail).

mira: good improvement. can you upload per-channel scale ratios (old vs stratified) and highlight dims where ratio outside [0.5,2.0]? those likely map to pt-tail clusters.

tao: uploaded CSV to eval report. flagged dims [9, 142, 301]. example: dim142 old_scale=0.0009 new_scale=0.0031 (ratio 3.4).

frank: that ratio flip indicates the dim was almost silent in pooled calib. when stratified we captured rare activations and widened the scale -> reduced rounding bias.

oz: next try: selective asymmetric per-channel quant for dims with activation_count < threshold OR skew>4. keep symmetric for others. that may reduce clipping on rare dims without changing global behavior.

tao: scheduling selective-asym run. also adding nn-distance histograms (k=200) intra vs inter to check whether intra-cluster variance increased or inter-cluster gap shrank.

mira: add a synthetic longtail regression test to CI: generate queries with token-frequency weight 0.01-0.1 quantiles and ensure recall@5 drop < 1.5 pts. helps prevent regression slips.

eval-bot: interim note: selective-asym run queued 1768129999/2. will append results to the report link above. :white_check_mark:

frank: once we have full results, open a small PR that: 1) switches default calib->stratified for embedding tables (flag on), 2) adds the synthetic longtail eval, 3) introduces selective-asym as opt-in. link it here for review.

tao: agreed. i'll run full stratified on all holdouts and the selective-asym experiment; if both green i'll draft the PR. will post back in ~40m. :coffee:
